subject: History
instructions:
Research report: Causes and course of the French Revolution.
Your report must:
- Explain the economic causes of the revolution
- Explain the social causes, including the three estates
- Describe the Reign of Terror
- Explain how Napoleon rose to power
- Use at least two primary sources
draft:
By 1789 France was close to bankruptcy. Wars, including support for the American Revolution, had drained the treasury, and poor harvests pushed bread prices so high that many families spent most of their income on food.
French society was split into three estates. The clergy and nobles paid little tax, while the Third Estate, about 97% of the population, carried nearly all of it.
In 1793 and 1794 Robespierre and the Committee of Public Safety sent thousands of suspected enemies to the guillotine in what became known as the Terror.
